i < size; ++i) {\n        const double ref = reference[i];\n        const double res = result[i];\n        if (std::abs(ref) < 1e-10) {\n            // For very small values, check absolute error\n            if (std::abs(res) > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e\\n\", i, ref, res);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Check relative error\n            const double relError = std::abs((res - ref) / ref);\n            if (relError > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e (rel error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, ref, res, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of rows/columns in the matrix (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Sparsity: 1 out of N entries is non-zero (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -m <val>     Maximum value for matrix and vector elements (default: 1.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    index_t numRows = 1024;\n    index_t sparsity = 10;\n    index_t iterations = 10;\n    double maxVal = 1.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numRows = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sparsity = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-m\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            maxVal = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Calculate number of non-zero elements\n    const index_t nItems = (numRows * numRows) / sparsity;\n\n    printf(\"Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV) Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %u x %u\\n\", numRows, numRows);\n    printf(\"Sparsity: 1 out of %u entries is non-zero\\n\", sparsity);\n    printf(\"Non-zero elements: %u (%.2f%% sparse)\\n\", \n           nItems, 100.0 * (1.0 - static_cast<double>(nItems) / (numRows * numRows)));\n    printf(\"Iterations: %u\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Max value: %.2f\\n\", maxVal);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n\n    // Allocate and initialize data structures\n    std::vector<double> h_val(nItems);                  // Non-zero values\n    std::vector<index_t> h_cols(nItems);                // Column indices\n    std::vector<index_t> h_rowDelimiters(numRows + 1);  // Row delimiters\n    std::vector<double> h_vec(numRows);                 // Dense vector\n    std::vector<double> h_out(numRows);                 // Output vector\n\n    printf(\"Initializing data structures...\\n\");\n    fill(h_vec.data(), numRows, maxVal);\n    fill(h_val.data(), nItems, maxVal);\n    initRandomMatrix(h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), nItems, numRows);\n\n    // For validation, compute reference solution\n    std::vector<double> h_reference;\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Computing reference solution...\\n\");\n        h_reference.resize(numRows);\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), \n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_reference.data());\n    }\n\n    // Perform SpMV computation\n    printf(\"Computing SpMV...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    for (index_t iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(),\n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_out.data());\n    }\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate performance metrics\n    const double gflops = (2.0 * nItems * iterations) / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    const double avgTime = duration.count() / static_cast<double>(iterations);\n    \n    printf(\"Average time per iteration: %.3f ms\\n\", avgTime);\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(h_out, \"OutputVector\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        const bool valid = verifyResults(h_reference.data(), h_out.data(), numRows);\n\n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n","numLines":262,"startLine":1,"totalLines":262}}}

Constants\\nconstexpr double MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR = 0.02;\\n\\n// ****************************************************************************\\n// Function: fill\\n//\\n// Purpose:\\n//   Initialize array with random values\\n//\\n// Arguments:\\n//   A: pointer to the array to initialize\\n//   n: number of elements in the array\\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\\n//\\n// ****************************************************************************\\nvoid fill(double* A, const index_t n, const double maxVal) {\\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n// ****************************************************************************\\n// Function: initRandomMatrix\\n//\\n// Purpose:\\n//   Assigns random positions to a given number of elements in a square\\n//   matrix. The function encodes these positions in compressed sparse\\n//   row (CSR) format.\\n//\\n// Arguments:\\n//   cols:          array for column indexes of elements (size should be = n)\\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\\n//   n:             number of nonzero elements\\n//   dim:           number of rows/columns in the matrix\\n//\\n// ****************************************************************************\\nvoid initRandomMatrix(index_t* cols, index_t* rowDelimiters, const index_t n, const index_t dim) {\\n    index_t nnzAssigned = 0;\\n\\n    // Figure out the probability that a nonzero should be assigned\\n    double prob = static_cast<double>(n) / (static_cast<double>(dim) * static_cast<double>(dim));\\n\\n    // Seed random number generator\\n    srand(8675309);\\n\\n    // Randomly decide whether entry i,j gets a value, but ensure n values are assigned\\n    bool fillRemaining = false;\\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\\n        rowDelimiters[i] = nnzAssigned;\\n        for (index_t j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {\\n            index_t numEntriesLeft = (dim * dim) - ((i * dim) + j);\\n            index_t needToAssign = n - nnzAssigned;\\n            if (numEntriesLeft <= needToAssign) {\\n                fillRemaining = true;\\n            }\\n            double randVal = static_cast<double>(rand()) / RAND_MAX;\\n            if ((nnzAssigned < n && randVal <= prob) || fillRemaining) {\\n                // Assign (i,j) a value\\n                cols[nnzAssigned] = j;\\n                nnzAssigned++;\\n            }\\n        }\\n    }\\n    // Convention: put the number of non-zeroes at the end of the row delimiters array\\n    rowDelimiters[dim] = n;\\n}\\n\\n// ****************************************************************************\\n// Function: spmvCpu\\n//\\n// Purpose:\\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format\\n//\\n// Arguments:\\n//   val: array holding the non-zero values for the matrix\\n//   cols: array of column indices for each element\\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\\n//   vec: dense vector of size dim to be used for multiplication\\n//   dim: number of rows/columns in the matrix\\n//   out: output - result from the spmv calculation\\n//\\n// ****************************************************************************\\nvoid spmvCpu(const double* val, const index_t* cols, const index_t* rowDelimiters,\\n             const double* vec, const index_t dim, double* out) {\\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\\n        double t = 0.0;\\n        for (index_t j = rowDelimiters[i]; j < rowDelimiters[i + 1]; ++j) {\\n            const auto col = cols[j];\\n            t += val[j] * vec[col];\\n        }\\n        out[i] = t;\\n    }\\n}\\n\\n// ****************************************************************************\\n// Function: verifyResults\\n//\\n// Purpose:\\n//   Verifies correctness of results by comparing to reference solution\\n//\\n// Arguments:\\n//   reference: array holding the reference result vector\\n//   result: array holding the result vector to verify\\n//   size: number of elements per vector\\n//\\n// ****************************************************************************\\nbool verifyResults(const double* reference, const double* result, const index_t size) {\\n    for (index_t i = 0; i <        }\\n        } else {\\n            // Check relative error\\n            const double relError = std::abs((res - ref) / ref);\\n            if (relError > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\\n                printf(\\\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e (rel error: %.10e)\\\\n\\\",\\n                       i, ref, res, relError);\\n                return false;\\n            }\\n        }\\n    }\\n    return true;\\n}\\n\\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\\n    printf(\\\"Usage: %s [options]\\\\n\\\", progName);\\n    printf(\\\"Options:\\\\n\\\");\\n    printf(\\\"  -n <num>     Number of rows/columns in the matrix (default: 1024)\\\\n\\\");\\n    printf(\\\"  -s <num>     Sparsity: 1 out of N entries is non-zero (default: 10)\\\\n\\\");\\n    printf(\\\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\\\n\\\");\\n    printf(\\\"  -m <val>     Maximum value for matrix and vector elements (default: 1.0)\\\\n\\\");\\n    printf(\\\"  -v           Enable validation\\\\n\\\");\\n    printf(\\\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\\\n\\\");\\n    printf(\\\"  -h           Show this help message\\\\n\\\");\\n}\\n\\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\\n    index_t numRows = 1024;\\n    index_t sparsity = 10;\\n    index_t iterations = 10;\\n    double maxVal = 1.0;\\n    bool validate = false;\\n    bool printResults = false;\\n\\n    // Parse command line arguments\\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \\\"-n\\\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\\n            numRows = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \\\"-s\\\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\\n            sparsity = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \\\"-i\\\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\\n            iterations = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \\\"-m\\\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\\n            maxVal = atof(argv[++i]);\\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \\\"-v\\\") == 0) {\\n            validate = true;\\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \\\"-r\\\") == 0) {\\n            printResults = true;\\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \\\"-h\\\") == 0) {\\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\\n            return 0;\\n        } else {\\n            printf(\\\"Unknown option: %s\\\\n\\\", argv[i]);\\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\\n            return 1;\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    // Calculate number of non-zero elements\\n    const index_t nItems = (numRows * numRows) / sparsity;\\n\\n    printf(\\\"Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV) Benchmark\\\\n\\\");\\n    printf(\\\"Matrix size: %u x %u\\\\n\\\", numRows, numRows);\\n    printf(\\\"Sparsity: 1 out of %u entries is non-zero\\\\n\\\", sparsity);\\n    printf(\\\"Non-zero elements: %u (%.2f%% sparse)\\\\n\\\", \\n           nItems, 100.0 * (1.0 - static_cast<double>(nItems) / (numRows * numRows)));\\n    printf(\\\"Iterations: %u\\\\n\\\", iterations);\\n    printf(\\\"Max value: %.2f\\\\n\\\", maxVal);\\n    printf(\\\"Validation: %s\\\\n\\\", validate ? \\\"enabled\\\" : \\\"disabled\\\");\\n\\n    // Allocate and initialize data structures\\n    std::vector<double> h_val(nItems);                  // Non-zero values\\n    std::vector<index_t> h_cols(nItems);                // Column indices\\n    std::vector<index_t> h_rowDelimiters(numRows + 1);  // Row delimiters\\n    std::vector<double> h_vec(numRows);                 // Dense vector\\n    std::vector<double> h_out(numRows);                 // Output vector\\n\\n    printf(\\\"Initializing data structures...\\\\n\\\");\\n    fill(h_vec.data(), numRows, maxVal);\\n    fill(h_val.data(), nItems, maxVal);\\n    initRandomMatrix(h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), nItems, numRows);\\n\\n    // For validation, compute reference solution\\n    std::vector<double> h_reference;\\n    if (validate) {\\n        printf(\\\"Computing reference solution...\\\\n\\\");\\n        h_reference.resize(numRows);\\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), \\n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_reference.data());\\n    }\\n\\n    // Perform SpMV computation\\n    printf(\\\"Computing SpMV...\\\\n\\\");\\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\\n\\n    for                                     \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                           \\\n        }                                                                           \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: fill\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Initialize array with random values\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   A: pointer to the array to initialize\n//   n: number of elements in the array\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid fill(double* A, const index_t n, const double maxVal) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: initRandomMatrix\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Assigns random positions to a given number of elements in a square\n//   matrix. The function encodes these positions in compressed sparse\n//   row (CSR) format.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   cols:          array for column indexes of elements (size should be = n)\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   n:             number of nonzero elements\n//   dim:           number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//\n// Note: This generation is kept strictly sequential (single rank) because\n// the random values assigned to each entry depend on the position in the\n// global rand() stream; parallelizing it would change the generated matrix.\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid initRandomMatrix(index_t* cols, index_t* rowDelimiters, const index_t n, const index_t dim) {\n    index_t nnzAssigned = 0;\n\n    // Figure out the probability that a nonzero should be assigned\n    double prob = static_cast<double>(n) / (static_cast<double>(dim) * static_cast<double>(dim));\n\n    // Seed random number generator\n    srand(8675309);\n\n    // Randomly decide whether entry i,j gets a value, but ensure n values are assigned\n    bool fillRemaining = false;\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        rowDelimiters[i] = nnzAssigned;\n        for (index_t j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {\n            index_t numEntriesLeft = (dim * dim) - ((i * dim) + j);\n            index_t needToAssign = n - nnzAssigned;\n            if (numEntriesLeft <= needToAssign) {\n                fillRemaining = true;\n            }\n            double randVal = static_cast<double>(rand()) / RAND_MAX;\n            if ((nnzAssigned < n && randVal <= prob) || fillRemaining) {\n                // Assign (i,j) a value\n                cols[nnzAssigned] = j;\n                nnzAssigned++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    // Convention: put the number of non-zeroes at the end of the row delimiters array\n    rowDelimiters[dim] = n;\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: spmvCpu\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format.\n//   Parallelized across rows with OpenMP; each row is an independent\n//   reduction so this does not change the per-row result.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   val: array holding the non-zero values for the matrix\n//   cols: array of column indices for each element\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   vec: dense vector of size dim to be used for multiplication\n//   dim: number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   out: output - result from the spmv calculation\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid spmvCpu(const double* val, const index_t* cols, const index_t* rowDelimiters,\n             const double* vec, const index_t dim, double* out) {\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 256)\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        double t = 0.0;\n        for (index_t j = rowDelimiters[i]; j < rowDelimiters[i + 1]; ++j) {\n            const auto col = cols[j];\n            t += val[j] * vec[col];\n        }\n        out[i] = t;\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Kernel: spmvKernel\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   CUDA kernel computing CSR SpMV with one warp assigned per matrix row.\n//   Non-zeros of a row are strided across the 32 lanes of the warp and the\n//   partial sums are combined with a warp shuffle reduction. This balances\n//   work across threads regardless of per-row non-zero variance.\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\n__global__ void spmvKernel(const double* __restrict__ val, const index_t* __restrict__ cols,\n                            const index_t* __restrict__ rowDelimiters,\n                            const double* __restrict__ vec, index_t numRows,\n                            double* __restrict__ out) {\n    const index_t warpId = (blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x) / warpSize;\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x % warpSize;\n    if (warpId >= numRows) return;\n\n    const index_t rowStart = rowDelimiters[warpId];\n    const index_t rowEnd = rowDelimiters[warpId + 1];\n\n    double sum = 0.0;\n    for (index_t j = rowStart + lane; j < rowEnd; j += warpSize) {\n        sum += val[j] * vec[cols[j]];\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {\n        sum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sum, offset);\n    }\n\n    if (lane == 0) {\n        out[warpId] = sum;\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: verifyResults\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Verifies correctness of results by comparing to reference solution\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   reference: array holding the reference result vector\n//   result: array holding the result vector to verify\n//   size: number of elements per vector\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nbool verifyResults(const double* reference, const double* result, const index_t size) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {\n        const double ref = reference[i];\n        const double res = result[i];\n        if (std::abs(ref) < 1e-10) {\n            // For very small values, check absolute error\n            if (std::abs(res) > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e\\n\", i, ref, res);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Check relative error\n            const double relError = std::abs((res - ref) / ref);\n            if (relError > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e (rel error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, ref, res, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of rows/columns in the matrix (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Sparsity: 1 out of N entries is non-zero (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -m <val>     Maximum value for matrix and vector elements (default: 1.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// Splits [0, numRows) into `size` contiguous row ranges that are\n// approximately balanced by non-zero count (not just row count), based on\n// the prefix sums already present in rowDelimiters.\nstatic void computeRowPartition(const std::vector<index_t>& rowDelimiters, index_t numRows,\n                                 index_t nItems, int size, std::vector<index_t>& rowSplits) {\n    rowSplits.assign(size + 1, 0);\n    rowSplits[size] = numRows;\n    for (int k = 1; k < size; ++k) {\n        const index_t target = static_cast<index_t>((static_cast<uint64_t>(nItems) * k) / size);\n        auto it = std::lower_bound(rowDelimiters.begin(), rowDelimiters.begin() + numRows + 1, target);\n        index_t row = static_cast<index_t>(it - rowDelimiters.begin());\n        row = std::min(row, numRows);\n        row = std::max(row, rowSplits[k - 1]);\n        rowSplits[k] = row;\n    }\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int worldSize = 1;\n    int worldRank = 0;\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldSize);\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldRank);\n    const bool isRoot = (worldRank == 0);\n\n    // Determine the node-local rank so that multiple ranks on the same node\n    // spread across the node's available GPUs.\n    MPI_Comm localComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, worldRank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &localComm);\n    int localRank = 0;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(localComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&localComm);\n\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount);\n    if (deviceCount <= 0) {\n        if (isRoot) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA-capable device found. This build requires a GPU per rank.\\n\");\n        }\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    const int device = localRank % deviceCount;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));\n\n    index_t numRows = 1024;\n    index_t sparsity = 10;\n    index_t iterations = 10;\n    double maxVal = 1.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (every rank receives the same argv from\n    // the launcher, so parsing independently keeps all ranks consistent\n    // without needing a broadcast).\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numRows = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sparsity = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-m\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            maxVal = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (isRoot) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (isRoot) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Calculate number of non-zero elements\n    const index_t nItems = (numRows * numRows) / sparsity;\n\n    if (isRoot) {\n        printf(\"Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV) Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Parallelization: MPI (%d ranks) + OpenMP (%d threads/rank) + CUDA (%d device(s)/node)\\n\",\n               worldSize, omp_get_max_threads(), deviceCount);\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %u x %u\\n\", numRows, numRows);\n        printf(\"Sparsity: 1 out of %u entries is non-zero\\n\", sparsity);\n        printf(\"Non-zero elements: %u (%.2f%% sparse)\\n\",\n               nItems, 100.0 * (1.0 - static_cast<double>(nItems) / (numRows * numRows)));\n        printf(\"Iterations: %u\\n\", iterations);\n        printf(\"Max value: %.2f\\n\", maxVal);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Full data structures are only materialized on rank 0: generation is\n    // an inherently sequential random process (see initRandomMatrix), and\n    // this way we avoid every rank paying the full memory cost.\n    std::vector<double> h_val;\n    std::vector<index_t> h_cols;\n    std::vector<index_t> h_rowDelimiters;\n    std::vector<double> h_vec(numRows);\n    std::vector<double> h_out;\n    std::vector<double> h_reference;\n\n    if      if (validate) {\n            printf(\"Computing reference solution...\\n\");\n            h_reference.resize(numRows);\n            spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(),\n                    h_vec.data(), numRows, h_reference.data());\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Broadcast the dense vector: every rank needs it in full since a\n    // locally-owned row's non-zeros can reference any global column.\n    MPI_Bcast(h_vec.data(), static_cast<int>(numRows), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    // Partition rows across ranks, balanced by non-zero count.\n    std::vector<index_t> rowSplits(worldSize + 1);\n    std::vector<int> valCounts(worldSize), valDispls(worldSize);\n    std::vector<int> rowCounts(worldSize), rowDispls(worldSize);\n\n    if (isRoot) {\n        computeRowPartition(h_rowDelimiters, numRows, nItems, worldSize, rowSplits);\n        for (int r = 0; r < worldSize; ++r) {\n            const index_t rs = rowSplits[r];\n            const index_t re = rowSplits[r + 1];\n            valCounts[r] = static_cast<int>(h_rowDelimiters[re] - h_rowDelimiters[rs]);\n            valDispls[r] = static_cast<int>(h_rowDelimiters[rs]);\n            rowCounts[r] = static_cast<int>(re - rs + 1);\n        }\n        rowDispls[0] = 0;\n        for (int r = 1; r < worldSize; ++r) {\n            rowDispls[r] = rowDispls[r - 1] + rowCounts[r - 1];\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Bcast(rowSplits.data(), worldSize + 1, MPI_UINT32_T, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    MPI_Bcast(valCounts.data(), worldSize, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    MPI_Bcast(valDispls.data(), worldSize, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    MPI_Bcast(rowCounts.data(), worldSize, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    MPI_Bcast(rowDispls.data(), worldSize, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    const index_t localNumRows = rowSplits[worldRank + 1] - rowSplits[worldRank];\n    const int localNnz = valCounts[worldRank];\n\n    std::vector<double> local_val(localNnz);\n    std::vector<index_t> local_cols(localNnz);\n    std::vector<index_t> local_rowDelim(localNumRows + 1);\n\n    MPI_Scatterv(isRoot ? h_val.data() : nullptr, valCounts.data(), valDispls.data(), local_rowDelim[i] -= localOffset;\n    }\n\n    std::vector<double> local_out(localNumRows);\n\n    // Device buffers.\n    double* d_val = nullptr;\n    index_t* d_cols = nullptr;\n    index_t* <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nusing index_t = uint32_t;\n\n// Constants\nconstexpr double MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR = 0.02;\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: fill\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Initialize array with random values\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   A: pointer to the array to initialize\n//   n: number of elements in the array\n//   maxVal: specifies range of random values [0, maxVal]\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid fill(double* A, const index_t n, const double maxVal) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: initRandomMatrix\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Assigns random positions to a given number of elements in a square\n//   matrix. The function encodes these positions in compressed sparse\n//   row (CSR) format.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   cols:          array for column indexes of elements (size should be = n)\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   n:             number of nonzero elements\n//   dim:           number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid initRandomMatrix(index_t* cols, index_t* rowDelimiters, const index_t n, const index_t dim) {\n    index_t nnzAssigned = 0;\n\n    // Figure out the probability that a nonzero should be assigned\n    double prob = static_cast<double>(n) / (static_cast<double>(dim) * static_cast<double>(dim));\n\n    // Seed random number generator\n    srand(8675309);\n\n    // Randomly decide whether entry i,j gets a value, but ensure n values are assigned\n    bool fillRemaining = false;\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        rowDelimiters[i] = nnzAssigned;\n        for (index_t j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {\n            index_t numEntriesLeft = (dim * dim) - ((i * dim) + j);\n            index_t needToAssign = n - nnzAssigned;\n            if (numEntriesLeft <= needToAssign) {\n                fillRemaining = true;\n            }\n            double randVal = static_cast<double>(rand()) / RAND_MAX;\n            if ((nnzAssigned < n && randVal <= prob) || fillRemaining) {\n                // Assign (i,j) a value\n                cols[nnzAssigned] = j;\n                nnzAssigned++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    // Convention: put the number of non-zeroes at the end of the row delimiters array\n    rowDelimiters[dim] = n;\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: spmvCpu\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   val: array holding the non-zero values for the matrix\n//   cols: array of column indices for each element\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   vec: dense vector of size dim to be used for multiplication\n//   dim: number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   out: output - result from the spmv calculation\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid spmvCpu(const double* val, const index_t* cols, const index_t* rowDelimiters,\n             const double* vec, const index_t dim, double* out) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        double t = 0.0;\n        for (index_t j = rowDelimiters[i]; j < rowDelimiters[i + 1]; ++j) {\n            const auto col = cols[j];\n            t += val[j] * vec[col];\n        }\n        out[i] = t;\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: verifyResults\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Verifies correctness of results by comparing to reference solution\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   reference: array holding the reference result vector\n//   result: array holding the result vector to verify\n//   size: number of elements per vector\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nbool verifyResults(const double* reference, const double* result, const index_t size) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {\n        const double ref = reference[i];\n        const double res = result[i];\n        if (std::abs(ref) < 1e-10) {\n            // For very small values, check absolute error\n            if (std::abs(res) > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e\\n\", i, ref, res);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Check relative error\n            const double relError = std::abs((res - ref) / ref);\n            if (relError > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e (rel error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, ref, res, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of rows/columns in the matrix (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Sparsity: 1 out of N entries is non-zero (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -m <val>     Maximum value for matrix and vector elements (default: 1.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    index_t numRows = 1024;\n    index_t sparsity = 10;\n    index_t iterations = 10;\n    double maxVal = 1.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numRows = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sparsity = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-m\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            maxVal = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Calculate number of non-zero elements\n    const index_t nItems = (numRows * numRows) / sparsity;\n\n    printf(\"Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV) Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %u x %u\\n\", numRows, numRows);\n    printf(\"Sparsity: 1 out of %u entries is non-zero\\n\", sparsity);\n    printf(\"Non-zero elements: %u (%.2f%% sparse)\\n\", \n           nItems, 100.0 * (1.0 - static_cast<double>(nItems) / (numRows * numRows)));\n    printf(\"Iterations: %u\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Max value: %.2f\\n\", maxVal);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n\n    // Allocate and initialize data structures\n    std::vector<double> h_val(nItems);                  // Non-zero values\n    std::vector<index_t> h_cols(nItems);                // Column indices\n    std::vector<index_t> h_rowDelimiters(numRows + 1);  // Row delimiters\n    std::vector<double> h_vec(numRows);                 // Dense vector\n    std::vector<double> h_out(numRows);                 // Output vector\n\n    printf(\"Initializing data structures...\\n\");\n    fill(h_vec.data(), numRows, maxVal);\n    fill(h_val.data(), nItems, maxVal);\n    initRandomMatrix(h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), nItems, numRows);\n\n    // For validation, compute reference solution\n    std::vector<double> h_reference;\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Computing reference solution...\\n\");\n        h_reference.resize(numRows);\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(), \n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_reference.data());\n    }\n\n    // Perform SpMV computation\n    printf(\"Computing SpMV...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    for (index_t iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        spmvCpu(h_val.data(), h_cols.data(), h_rowDelimiters.data(),\n                h_vec.data(), numRows, h_out.data());\n    }\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate performance metrics\n    const double gflops = (2.0 * nItems * iterations) / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    const double avgTime = duration.count() / static_cast<double>(iterations);\n    \n    printf(\"Average time per iteration: %.3f ms\\n\", avgTime);\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(h_out, \"OutputVector\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        const bool valid = verifyResults(h_reference.data(), h_out.data(), numRows);\n\n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n","userModified":false}}

i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i] = maxVal * (rand() / (static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) + 1.0));\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: initRandomMatrix\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Assigns random positions to a given number of elements in a square\n//   matrix. The function encodes these positions in compressed sparse\n//   row (CSR) format.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   cols:          array for column indexes of elements (size should be = n)\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   n:             number of nonzero elements\n//   dim:           number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//\n// Note: This generation is kept strictly sequential (single rank) because\n// the random values assigned to each entry depend on the position in the\n// global rand() stream; parallelizing it would change the generated matrix.\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid initRandomMatrix(index_t* cols, index_t* rowDelimiters, const index_t n, const index_t dim) {\n    index_t nnzAssigned = 0;\n\n    // Figure out the probability that a nonzero should be assigned\n    double prob = static_cast<double>(n) / (static_cast<double>(dim) * static_cast<double>(dim));\n\n    // Seed random number generator\n    srand(8675309);\n\n    // Randomly decide whether entry i,j gets a value, but ensure n values are assigned\n    bool fillRemaining = false;\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        rowDelimiters[i] = nnzAssigned;\n        for (index_t j = 0; j < dim; ++j) {\n            index_t numEntriesLeft = (dim * dim) - ((i * dim) + j);\n            index_t needToAssign = n - nnzAssigned;\n            if (numEntriesLeft <= needToAssign) {\n                fillRemaining = true;\n            }\n            double randVal = static_cast<double>(rand()) / RAND_MAX;\n            if ((nnzAssigned < n && randVal <= prob) || fillRemaining) {\n                // Assign (i,j) a value\n                cols[nnzAssigned] = j;\n                nnzAssigned++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    // Convention: put the number of non-zeroes at the end of the row delimiters array\n    rowDelimiters[dim] = n;\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: spmvCpu\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Computes sparse matrix-vector multiplication using CSR format.\n//   Parallelized across rows with OpenMP; each row is an independent\n//   reduction so this does not change the per-row result.\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   val: array holding the non-zero values for the matrix\n//   cols: array of column indices for each element\n//   rowDelimiters: array of size dim+1 holding indices to rows;\n//                  last element is the index one past the last element\n//   vec: dense vector of size dim to be used for multiplication\n//   dim: number of rows/columns in the matrix\n//   out: output - result from the spmv calculation\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nvoid spmvCpu(const double* val, const index_t* cols, const index_t* rowDelimiters,\n             const double* vec, const index_t dim, double* out) {\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 256)\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < dim; ++i) {\n        double t = 0.0;\n        for (index_t j = rowDelimiters[i]; j < rowDelimiters[i + 1]; ++j) {\n            const auto col = cols[j];\n            t += val[j] * vec[col];\n        }\n        out[i] = t;\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Kernel: spmvKernel\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   CUDA kernel computing CSR SpMV with one warp assigned per matrix row.\n//   Non-zeros of a row are strided across the 32 lanes of the warp and the\n//   partial sums are combined with a warp shuffle reduction. This balances\n//   work across threads regardless of per-row non-zero variance.\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\n__global__ void spmvKernel(const double* __restrict__ val, const index_t* __restrict__ cols,\n                            const index_t* __restrict__ rowDelimiters,\n                            const double* __restrict__ vec, index_t numRows,\n                            double* __restrict__ out) {\n    const index_t warpId = (blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x) / warpSize;\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x % warpSize;\n    if (warpId >= numRows) return;\n\n    const index_t rowStart = rowDelimiters[warpId];\n    const index_t rowEnd = rowDelimiters[warpId + 1];\n\n    double sum = 0.0;\n    for (index_t j = rowStart + lane; j < rowEnd; j += warpSize) {\n        sum += val[j] * vec[cols[j]];\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {\n        sum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sum, offset);\n    }\n\n    if (lane == 0) {\n        out[warpId] = sum;\n    }\n}\n\n// ****************************************************************************\n// Function: verifyResults\n//\n// Purpose:\n//   Verifies correctness of results by comparing to reference solution\n//\n// Arguments:\n//   reference: array holding the reference result vector\n//   result: array holding the result vector to verify\n//   size: number of elements per vector\n//\n// ****************************************************************************\nbool verifyResults(const double* reference, const double* result, const index_t size) {\n    for (index_t i = 0; i < size; ++i) {\n        const double ref = reference[i];\n        const double res = result[i];\n        if (std::abs(ref) < 1e-10) {\n            // For very small values, check absolute error\n            if (std::abs(res) > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e\\n\", i, ref, res);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Check relative error\n            const double relError = std::abs((res - ref) / ref);\n            if (relError > MAX_RELATIVE_ERROR) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at index %u: reference %.10e, got %.10e (rel error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, ref, res, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of rows/columns in the matrix (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Sparsity: 1 out of N entries is non-zero (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -m <val>     Maximum value for matrix and vector elements (default: 1.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// Splits [0, numRows) into `size` contiguous row ranges that are\n// approximately balanced by non-zero count (not just row count), based on\n// the prefix sums already present in rowDelimiters.\nstatic void computeRowPartition(const std::vector<index_t>& rowDelimiters, index_t numRows,\n                                 index_t nItems, int size, std::vector<index_t>& rowSplits) {\n    rowSplits.assign(size + 1, 0);\n    rowSplits[size] = numRows;\n    for (int k = 1; k < size; ++k) {\n        const index_t target = static_cast<index_t>((static_cast<uint64_t>(nItems) * k) / size);\n        auto it = std::lower_bound(rowDelimiters.begin(), rowDelimiters.begin() + numRows + 1, target);\n        index_t row = static_cast<index_t>(it - rowDelimiters.begin());\n        row = std::min(row, numRows);\n        row = std::max(row, rowSplits[k - 1]);\n        rowSplits[k] = row;\n    }\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int worldSize = 1;\n    int worldRank = 0;\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldSize);\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldRank);\n    const bool isRoot = (worldRank == 0);\n\n    // Determine the node-local rank so that multiple ranks on the same node\n    // spread across the node's available GPUs.\n    MPI_Comm localComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, worldRank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &localComm);\n    int localRank = 0;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(localComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&localComm);\n\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount);\n    if (deviceCount <= 0) {\n        if (isRoot) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA-capable device found. This build requires a GPU per rank.\\n\");\n        }\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    const int device = localRank % deviceCount;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));\n\n    index_t numRows = 1024;\n    index_t sparsity = 10;\n    index_t iterations = 10;\n    double maxVal = 1.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (every rank receives the same argv from\n    // the launcher, so parsing independently keeps all ranks consistent\n    // without needing a broadcast).\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numRows = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sparsity = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = static_cast<index_t>(atoi(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-m\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            maxVal = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (isRoot) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (isRoot) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Calculate number of non-zero elements\n    const index_t nItems = (numRows * numRows) / sparsity;\n\n    if (isRoot) {\n        printf(\"Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV) Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Parallelization: MPI (%d ranks) + OpenMP (%d threads/rank) + CUDA (%d device(s)/node)\\n\",\n               worldSize, omp_get_max_threads(), deviceCount);\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %u x %u\\n\", numRows, numRows);\n        printf(\"Sparsity: 1 out of %u entries is non-zero\\n\", sparsity);\n
